cases.question: When and where does Northstar Summer Lab 2026 take place?
required_facts: The program runs from 3 August through 14 August 2026.
It takes place at Meridian Innovation Campus, Orion Building, 42 Polaris Avenue, Ankara.
cases.expected_answer_snippet: 3–14 August 2026 at Meridian Innovation Campus, Orion Building, 42 Polaris Avenue, Ankara

cases.question: I will reach campus after 20:00 on arrival day. What must I do, and whom should I contact?
required_facts: Call the Residence Duty Phone before 19:30 to arrange late key collection.
Send the revised arrival time to the Program Office.
The Residence Duty Phone is +90 312 555 0149.
The Program Office email is program@northstar.example.
cases.expected_answer_snippet: Call +90 312 555 0149 before 19:30 and notify program@northstar.example of the revised arrival time

cases.question: What laptop specifications should I prepare for the lab?
required_facts: The recommended minimum is 16 GB RAM.
The laptop should have 60 GB of free storage after updates.
It should support Wi-Fi 5 or newer and have a working browser and USB port.
The participant needs permission to install software and local development tools.
cases.expected_answer_snippet: 16 GB RAM, 60 GB free storage, Wi-Fi 5 or newer, a browser and USB port, and installation rights

cases.question: What happens if I miss the mandatory safety induction?
required_facts: The participant may continue software-only work.
They cannot enter the Fabrication Studio until completing a make-up induction with the Safety Officer.
cases.expected_answer_snippet: Continue software-only work and arrange a make-up induction with the Safety Officer before entering the Fabrication Studio

cases.question: I booked the 12:30 departure shuttle on 15 August. How do checkout and luggage storage work?
required_facts: Checkout and key return are due by 10:00.
The participant can place luggage in the tagged ground-floor storage room until 12:15 after checkout.
cases.expected_answer_snippet: Check out by 10:00, return the key, and leave tagged luggage in ground-floor storage until 12:15

cases.question: If threatening conduct creates immediate danger, what must I do first, and how do I report the conduct afterward? Include the exact contacts.
required_facts: The immediate emergency procedure takes priority over confidential conduct reporting.
Call campus emergency extension 5555 or +90 312 555 0155.
A conduct concern can also be reported to the Conduct Lead at conduct@northstar.example once immediate safety is addressed.
cases.expected_answer_snippet: Use 5555 or +90 312 555 0155 first, then report through the Conduct Lead when it is safe

cases.question: When is the evacuation drill, and where should people in Orion Building assemble?
required_facts: The scheduled drill is at 11:30 on Tuesday, 4 August.
Orion Building occupants assemble at North Lawn beside the blue beacon.
cases.expected_answer_snippet: 11:30 on Tuesday, 4 August, at North Lawn beside the blue beacon

cases.question: What must I return with a loan laptop, and how does that deadline relate to the team handoff?
required_facts: Return the loan laptop, charger, and sleeve by 17:30 on Friday, 14 August.
The project team handoff is due at 17:00 on 14 August, 30 minutes before the equipment return deadline.
cases.expected_answer_snippet: The team handoff is due at 17:00; return the laptop, charger, and sleeve by 17:30
